messages.content: Each paragraph of your response must end with the same word it started with, separate paragraphs with a newline.  Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy is a concept that will likely remain relevant, though its definition may shift. Privacy

Consciousness copying is currently far beyond our technological capabilities and faces immense philosophical hurdles. Consciousness

Wireless connectivity is expanding rapidly, yet covering every inch of the planet remains a logistical challenge. Wireless

Electric transport is gaining traction, but heavy industry and aviation face significant battery density barriers. Electric

Climate change effects are already locking in certain changes due to historical emissions and inertia. Climate

Physical money is declining in usage, but it may persist for emergency or offline transaction needs. Physical

Genetic secrets are being unraveled, but achieving centuries of life involves complex biological systems we barely understand. Genetic
